opening.argument: The video offers recurring weekly trading income while requiring participants to fund an account and recruit others who deposit money. It says, "Each member gets 40 percent of the trading profits once a week," then presents a binary plan requiring one recruit on each side with a minimum $200 deposit. It further promises, "you will automatically receive a 10% direct referral bonus of the deposited funds." Alongside assurances of 100% security and a transparent platform, this structure ties earnings to recruitment and deposited funds, not merely to neutral discussion of trading. The closing instruction—"Call us! Sign up! And start earning today!"—makes the message an active solicitation to participate and earn.
